case_title: Saloni Arora v. State of NCT of Delhi
statutory_provisions: IPC s.182, s.195; Code of Criminal Procedure s.195
neutral_facts: The case involves a criminal proceeding where the accused was sought to be prosecuted under Sections 120-B, 201, 302, 364, and 365 of the Indian Penal Code. The State Prosecuting Agency attempted to prosecute the accused for an offence under Section 182 of the IPC. The accused filed an application for discharge, arguing that the prosecution did not follow the procedure prescribed under Section 195 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The Trial Court dismissed the application, and the High Court upheld this decision. The Supreme Court reviewed the matter and found that the prosecution's action was void ab initio as it did not comply with the procedure under Section 195 of the Code.
